og.h1: The Big Four post 65.4% of India's technology-risk roles. 58.2% of them ask for an engineering degree.
og.foot: Share of India's 292 technology-risk roles, 16 November 2026 · himyro.com

slides.h1: The Big Four post 65.4% of India's technology-risk roles. 58.2% of them ask for an engineering degree.
slides.sub: 292 of 1,113 live risk and compliance roles on 260+ MNC career pages in India, read 16 November 2026.
slides.caption: If you are a software engineer looking for a way into risk, the seat is technology risk, and the Big Four post most of it. Deloitte, EY and KPMG post 65.4% of these roles, and 58.2% of them ask for an engineering degree.

slides.note: Deloitte, KPMG and EY: 191 of 292 roles, 65.4%.
slides.caption: Deloitte posts 131 technology-risk roles, 44.9% of all of them. KPMG posts 31 (10.6%) and EY 29 (9.9%). Infosys (11) and Cognizant (9) come next.

slides.note: Share of roles whose postings name the skill. Each role counted once.
slides.caption: Cloud appears in 49.3% of technology-risk roles, against 15.5% across the rest of the lane. Identity and access appears in 39.4%, against 11.3%. Python appears in 8.6%.

slides.sub: of technology-risk roles ask for a B.Tech, computer science, IT or MCA degree. Across the rest of the lane, 15.1%. At the Big Four, 72.3%.
slides.caption: At the Big Four, 72.3% of these roles ask for an engineering degree. Across the rest of the risk lane, 15.1% do.

slides.sub: roles name CISSP, and 102 name ISO 27001. CISA appears in 95 and NIST in 87. Credit risk appears in 1.
slides.caption: ISO 27001 is named in 102 roles and NIST in 87. CISSP appears in 102, CISA in 95 and CISM in 58. The usual advice runs through credit-risk models: credit risk appears in 1 of the 292.

slides.sub: of roles that state experience ask for five years or less. 13 of 292 are entry level.
slides.caption: 200 of the 292 roles state a minimum experience. 130 of those (65.0%) ask for five years or less, and 74 (37.0%) for three or less. 13 are entry level.

slides.sub: of technology-risk roles are posted in Bengaluru. Mumbai has 23.6% and Delhi NCR 18.2%.
slides.caption: Bengaluru has 44.9% of technology-risk roles. Mumbai has 23.6% and Delhi NCR 18.2%, then Pune (11.3%) and Hyderabad (10.3%). 39.4% of these roles were first posted in the 30 days before we read them.

slides.sub: build roles sit inside the risk lane. Goldman Sachs posts 7. They ask for cloud, Python, Java and SQL.
slides.caption:
23 build roles sit inside the risk lane. Goldman Sachs posts 7, Wipro 3, American Express 2 and Deloitte 2.
